audience: moving companies that run leads, estimates, jobs and crews in MoveitPro+

useCases.title: Work the follow-up call list
useCases.text: Open the follow-up queue to see which leads are due for a call. Check the contact log to see the last contact with each one.

useCases.title: Check the crew plan for a move day
useCases.text: List the jobs booked for a move date and the crew assignments for each job. Read the crew list to see which crews are active.

useCases.title: Review completed move revenue by month
useCases.text: Get the completed revenue for each month, up to 12 months. Open the bills of a job to see its charges line by line.

useCases.title: Check the payments for an estimate
useCases.text: Read an estimate's price breakdown, invoices and signed documents. List the payments for that estimate or customer.

useCases.title: Log a call and create a follow-up task
useCases.text: Log a call on a lead or customer in the contact log. Then create a task with a due date to send a revised quote.

useCases.title: Add a new lead from a real inquiry
useCases.text: Create a lead for a real inquiry. The lead starts a draft estimate with the move date and addresses, and the office gets an alert.
